text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-8421 fired: http_5xx_rate > 4% (1m) for service=inference-gateway us-west1. Auto-escalation in 8m if unacked.

pagerduty: Assigned to nicholas (oncall) — page via phone.

nicholas (oncall): ack — I'm on it. quick check: is impact customer-facing or internal test traffic?

sara (support): seeing 3 customer reports of persistent 502s for bulk embedding batch calls, started ~35s ago. Ticket IDs attached to support queue.

priya (runtime): looking at runtime logs — spikes of KV cache miss and rapid evictions around same time. Also seeing many upstream 502s from model-side pods. Might be a cascading retry pattern.

james (network): LB logs show upstream reset (RST) + 502s from a subset of pods behind the gateway. Could be pod-level resource exhaustion or kernel OOMs.

nicholas (oncall): quick reproducibility check — running curl against health endpoint and a simple generate call:

ops-bot: ```bash
curl -s -I https://gateway-usw1.redwood.example/v1/health
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/json

curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null -X POST https://gateway-usw1.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
502
```

priya (runtime): confirmed. attaching short logs snippet:

ops-bot: ```
2026-03-15T02:25:10Z runtime[gw-7f8]: kvcache: evict key batch-xyz size=128 -> reason=pressure
2026-03-15T02:25:10Z runtime[gw-7f8]: http: upstream error 502 model-0/10.2.1.4: connection reset
2026-03-15T02:25:11Z runtime[gw-7f8]: retry-loop: 429/503 backoff exhausted for request id=abc123
```

james (network): pod status looks OK for most, but two pods show `RestartCount>3` and `OOMKilled` in events. Could be a hot path in KV refills causing memory spike.

nicholas (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable aggressive client retries at edge (reduce retry fanout), 2) start draining the 2 failing pods, 3) enable routing fallback to warm-standby model pool to reduce load on model pods. who can flip runtime fallback?

priya (runtime): I can flip fallback. applying a safety rollout to route 20% to standby then 50% if stable. config snippet I'm about to patch:

ops-bot: ```yaml
routing:
  inference-gateway:
    fallback_variant: standby-small
    rollout: 20%
    health_check: 5s
```

priya (runtime): patched and pushed. monitoring watch on 30s.

james (network): draining pods gw-7f8 and gw-3c2 now. kubectl commands: ```bash
kubectl -n prod cordon node-12
kubectl -n prod drain gw-7f8 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30 --delete-local-data
```

nicholas (oncall): reducing client-side retries at the edge policy to prevent retry storms. ops-bot shows policy update applied.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421 escalated to team lead after 8m (no heartbeat from mitigation).

sara (support): letting affected customers know we are mitigating; ETA estimate 10-15m. asking for list of impacted orgs for targeted outreach.

priya (runtime): after rollout to standby 20% we see immediate drop in 5xx rate to ~1.2% across us-west1. continuing to ramp to 50%.

ops-bot: ```bash
# quick health check after routing change
curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null -X POST https://gateway-usw1.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
200
```

nicholas (oncall): good. keeping pods drained and monitoring for recurrence. moving to incident containment state.

james (network): capturing node-level diagnostics and OOM traces; uploading to /artifacts/incidents/PD-8421/. Will hand over to infra for RCA.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-8421: auto-escalation suppressed (mitigation in progress).

nicholas (oncall): prepping incident ticket IN-2026-321: summary, timeline, actions taken, customers impacted, follow-ups (RCA, postmortem, config change to retry policy, longer-term kvcache tuning).

sara (support): outreach drafts ready, will send once nicholas confirms customers list.

nicholas (oncall): handing off to rachel (night-oncall) in 20m. rachel — you'll get the incident ticket and postmortem assignment if anything regresses. key actions to continue: monitor 5xx, confirm standby pool stability, complete pod diagnostics upload, coordinate customer comms.

rachel (night-oncall): ack — taking handoff. will keep watch and escalate if 5xx > 2% for 5m.

nicholas (oncall): final note: short-term mitigation worked (fallback routing + draining). RCA items: investigate kv cache eviction policy under bursty retry loads, add preemptive autoscale headroom for model pods, and consider smarter retry backoff at the gateway.

ops-bot: Incident recorded IN-2026-321; artifacts created; follow-up assignment: runtime-team, infra-team, support.

nicholas (oncall): closing this page — will open full postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
